summary: 6 features and 3 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • mono-specs: add repository search aliases (07ec354)

HagiCode-org/web

  • tour: add guided management onboarding (24a24f1)
  • repository: search repositories by code alias (0406687)
  • wizard: add searchable model selection (77f0a6a)
  • conversation: add queued empty state and message expansion (e1ee097)
  • conversation: render theme-aware Mermaid diagrams (4f482ce)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • prompts: align commit summary format (a114ff1)

HagiCode-org/web

  • wizard: preserve project creation fallback state (8f84c59)
  • statusbar: stabilize achievement notifications and session headers (0b27e88)
